oauth_credentials.title: Access credentials

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: The client ID from the OAuth application used to authenticate the user.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret from the OAuth application used to authenticate the user.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained through Hubspot's OAuth flow from an account with Super Admin access.

oauth_credentials.description: Please use a Hubspot account with Super Admin access. Using an account with insufficient permissions will result in an error.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Records created or updated after the start date will be extracted from the source.

enable_leads_stream.title: Enable Leads stream
enable_leads_stream.description: Whether to enable Leads stream or not. Note you need to have Hubspot Pro or Enterprise for this to work.

extract_deal_associations.title: Extract deal associations
extract_deal_associations.description: Enable the extraction of entities associated with deals. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_deal_associations_comma_separate.title: Deal associations entities (comma separated)
extract_deal_associations_comma_separate.default: calls, commerce_payments, communications, companies, contacts, deal_split, deals, emails, invoices, line_item, meetings, notes, orders, postal_mail, quotes, services, subscriptions, tasks, tickets
extract_deal_associations_comma_separate.description: Comma separated list with the name of entities that should be extracted, e.g.: "companies, contacts".

extract_contact_associations.title: Extract contact associations
extract_contact_associations.description: Enable the extraction of entities associated with contacts. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_contact_associations_comma_separ.title: Contact associations entities (comma separated)
extract_contact_associations_comma_separ.default: calls, communications, companies, contacts, emails, meetings, notes, subscriptions, tasks, tickets
extract_contact_associations_comma_separ.description: Comma separated list with the name of entities that should be extracted, e.g.: "companies, contacts".

extract_contact_property_history_comma_s.description: Comma separated list with the name of the properties that should be extracted, e.g.: "lifecyclestage, hs_lastmodifieddate".

property_objects.title: Property objects (comma separated)
property_objects.default: calls, communication, company, contacts, deals, email, line_item, meeting, notes, postal_mail, product, task, tickets
property_objects.description: Comma separated list of HubSpot object types to fetch property definitions for.

properties_as_json_string.title: Properties as JSON string
properties_as_json_string.description: When enabled, the 'properties' column is emitted as a JSON string instead of a structured object. Use this to work around destination limits on the number of nested fields (e.g. BigQuery's 10,000 field limit).
